product_metadata.title: Butterfly Craze Daisy Lounge Flower Pillow - Cozy & Stylish Floor Cushion, Perfect Seating Solution for Teens & Kids, Machine Washable Aesthetic Decor, Plush Microfiber, Large 35" Diameter, Green
features: COZY AESTHETIC: This Butterfly Craze Flower Daisy Pillow with its plush construction and vibrant color options is a versatile addition to any big or small room in your home, making it a practical solution for comfortable seating with a touch of aesthetic elegance. Whether you're looking for a large or medium floor pillow to spruce up your living room, or a kids' floor cushion to make reading time even cozier, this pillow lounger is the perfect choice for those who love hippie room décor.

PERFECT FOR ALL AGES: Our trendy daisy floor pillow is perfect for all ages. Available in a variety of colors, from soft pinks to muted blues, it complements any design aesthetic. Add personality to your child's playroom or college dorm with this fun and stylish cushion. Its cozy and inviting design makes it a must-have for any room in your home. With comfort and style, it also makes a great gift. Enhance your space today and bring a touch of charm to your pastel room décor.

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR PREFERENCE: Get cozy for family game night with our versatile floor pillows. With two sizes to choose from - Large (35" diameter) and Medium (20" diameter) - you can mix and match to suit your seating needs. Create a lounge area with a single large pillow or add extra seating with two medium-sized pillows. The possibilities are endless, so why not bring a touch of comfort and relaxation to your den with these medium and giant floor pillows!

EPITOME OF COMFORT & QUALITY: Made from the finest microfiber fabric, it feels ultra-soft and smooth to the touch, like velvet. The plush material not only provides unbeatable comfort but also durability, ensuring that it retains its shape and luxury feel for years to come. Perfect for lounging on the floor, reading a book or just relaxing, this pillow is the ultimate addition to your home décor. Indulge in ultimate comfort and elevate your living space with this luxurious floor pillow cushion.

MACHINE WASHABLE: This floor cushion is not only stain resistant but also machine washable, making it incredibly easy to clean. For quick touch-ups, simply spot-clean with a damp cloth or sponge. For a deeper cleanse, feel free to machine wash it on a gentle cycle with cold water. To retain its pristine condition, air drying is recommended. This cushion is perfect for those seeking both comfort and low-maintenance solutions with its hassle-free cleaning and practicality.
